ModMetaData.name: Deep Reserves
ModMetaData.author: Sk
ModMetaData.description: When you hover a revealed deep-resource tile with a deep scanner or built deep drill selected, this mod keeps vanilla's per-tile readout and adds the total resource remaining in that entire connected deposit right below it, instead of just the one cell under your cursor. While placing a deep drill, it instead shows the total of each resource type actually reachable within that drill's mining range, so you can see what it will dig up before you build it.
